Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.config

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.config
Reads configuration values through one small interface, so the same code runs on a server, on Android and in a test.

ConfigSource is the port. The adapters are MapConfigSource for values written in code, PropertiesConfigSource for .properties files, streams and classpath resources, EnvConfigSource for environment variables, and LayeredConfigSource to put several of them in priority order. Keys are dot-separated, such as database.connections.main.host.

This package does not hold the typed database configuration built from these values, nor any code that opens a connection. No adapter prints a value from toString, because values can be passwords.
